verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents API Metrics (call volume, endpoint usage, errors) and MCP call analytics, plus a feedback capture mechanism (Suggest in GitHub for typos/feedback), giving some visibility into usage and reader input. However, there is no evidence of page-view analytics for docs pages or search-term tracking, which are core parts of the story. Missing for 10: page-view analytics dashboard, search-term/query analytics, and independent corroboration of these insights being actionable for a DevRel lead.
